crossRefs.note: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for…
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will…
I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you…

translations.web: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?
translations.bsb: What will you do on the appointed day, on the day of the LORD’s feast?
translations.kjv: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
translations.asv: What will ye do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Jehovah?
